disposition_reason: Market survey of three lettuce types (soil and hydroponic) with min, max, mean and median for total As, Cd and Pb in Table 3.

study.design: Market survey of three lettuce types, soil-grown and hydroponic, with health risk assessment
study.origin: Soil-grown or hydroponic lettuce, growing location not stated
study.market: Local markets in 15 districts and 6 fresh supermarkets, Bangkok, Thailand
study.method: HNO3/H2O2 hot-block digestion (US EPA method), ICP-MS (Agilent 7500c)
study.qa: NIST SRM 1573a tomato leaves (As and Cd recovery 101%) and SRM 1643e water (97%); blanks

controls.outcome: tAs mean 0.06 (soil) vs 0.04 (hydroponic) mg/kg; Cd mean 0.26 (soil) vs 0.12 (hydroponic) mg/kg; Pb mean 0.19 (soil) vs 0.09 (hydroponic) mg/kg. Paper reports no significant difference for As or Pb between types or methods; soil-grown red coral Cd significantly higher.

tAs mean 0.04 (soil) vs 0.03 (hydroponic) mg/kg; Cd mean 0.23 (soil) vs 0.16 (hydroponic) mg/kg; Pb mean 0.15 (soil) vs 0.14 (hydroponic) mg/kg. Paper reports no significant difference for As or Pb between types or methods; soil-grown red coral Cd significantly higher.

tAs mean 0.06 (soil) vs 0.04 (hydroponic) mg/kg; Cd mean 0.18 (soil) vs 0.11 (hydroponic) mg/kg; Pb mean 0.13 (soil) vs 0.12 (hydroponic) mg/kg. Paper reports no significant difference for As or Pb between types or methods; soil-grown red coral Cd significantly higher.

unresolved: Results basis not labeled: samples were oven-dried at 60 C and moisture was measured, but Table 3 does not say whether mg/kg is dry or fresh weight.
Text says As in soil-grown red coral and coral lettuce exceeded the WHO 0.1 mg/kg, but the Table 3 means are 0.06 mg/kg (only the maxima exceed).
Text says all hydroponic types had Cd above the standard, but the hydroponic means (0.11 to 0.16 mg/kg) are below the printed 0.2 mg/kg.
Table 4 hydroponic coral lettuce adult HI is printed as 0.17 although its HQs (0.58 + 0.45 + 0.14) sum to 1.17.
Pb SRM recovery not reported (only As and Cd recoveries of 101% and 97%).
Printed abstract ranges conflict with some Table 3 minima and maxima (flagged on the affected rows).
